description: Inside this strange structure, a heavy cacophony of bangs, clashes, explosions, and laughter echoes from rows of metal cabinets. A giant stethoscope stands near the center, clutching three large empty jars.

stone_wall.description: Walls lined with high cabinets containing locked, murmuring sound jars.

stone_floor.description: A stable floor paved with dark marble slabs.

exit_north.description: Back north to the Land of Endless Jumping.

exit_west.description: A dark, overgrown archway leading west into the Forgotten Forest.

conditions.failMessage: The stethoscope blocks the archway! 'NO ONE LEAVES WITHOUT CONTRIBUTING A SCREAM!' he shouts.

stethoscope.description: The Scream Collector himself, pacing eagerly.

trades.name: Obsidian Shard for Syrup Waffle
trades.description: Trade 1 Obsidian Shard for a sweet Syrup Waffle (+8 HP).

trades.name: Gorilla Hair for Magical Pasta
trades.description: Trade 1 Gorilla Hair for 1 Magical Pasta (Extra Life / Auto-Revive).

trades.name: Wild Potato for Energy Drink
trades.description: Trade 1 Wild Potato for a fizzing Sparking Energy Drink.

dialogue.text: "BEHOLD THE SCREAM COLLECTOR!" bellows Dr. Stethoscope. "SCREAM INTO THIS JAR!" (Hint: Stand here and execute the 'scream' command!)
"BEAUTIFUL SCREAM! I WILL USE THIS WELL!" yells the stethoscope, screwing the jar lid tight. "Here, take this shiny Stethoscope Bell from my cabinet. Now you may pass west!"
"I'm always collecting soundwaves and rare starch! Check out my TRADING POST if you have any cool shards or hair!"
